name: comp-162
title: Icon Radio Card Grid
blurb: Grid of icon cards, one radio button selected at a time.
description: Radio group options rendered as icon cards in a grid layout. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use_when: Choosing from a small set of tool options or features where icons clearly represent each choice.
avoid_when: When icons are ambiguous or tooltips are the only way to understand them.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with proper labels. Icons marked as aria-hidden with text labels accompanying.
